title: MAJOR: Negative limit wraps to large u32 via unchecked cast
description:
In `letta-server/src/tools/memory_unified/passages.rs` (lines 26-32), `request.limit` is `Option<i32>` and cast to `u32` via `as u32`.

**Problem:**
- If caller supplies a negative value (e.g., -1), `-1i32 as u32 == 4294967295`
- This could trigger an enormous query or other unexpected behavior

**Same issue exists on line 85.**

**Proposed fix:**
Use `try_into()` or clamp to zero:
```rust
limit: request.limit.and_then(|l| if l >= 0 { Some(l as u32) } else { None }),
```

MAJOR: list_archives wraps all archives into single passages element
description:
The `handle_list_archives` function in `letta-server/src/tools/memory_unified/archives.rs` (lines 18-38) has a response structure mismatch.

**Problem:**
- `count` is set to `archives.len()`
- But `passages` contains a single `Value` (the serialized array of all archives)
- A consumer iterating `archival.passages` expecting one passage per archive will only see one element

**Proposed fix:**
Serialize each archive individually into the passages vec:
```rust
archival: Some(ArchivalSearchResult {
    passages: archives.iter().map(|a| serde_json::to_value(a)).collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?,
    count,
}),
```

description: The vendored letta-rs SDK (v0.1.3, forked from orual/letta-rs) was last updated for Letta 0.15.1. Our Letta instance is now running 0.16.4 with 186 API endpoints. While existing MCP tool operations still work (archival-memory, sources, agents, tools, etc.), several new API areas are not covered by the SDK. This epic tracks adding support for new 0.16.x APIs and verifying type compatibility.
notes:
Current state:
- SDK: vendored at /opt/stacks/letta-MCP-server/rust/vendor/letta (v0.1.3)
- Fork: github.com/oculairmedia/letta-rs branch add-missing-endpoints (3 commits ahead of upstream)
- Upstream: orual/letta-rs v0.1.2 on crates.io (dormant since Jul 2025)
- Letta API: 0.16.4 running at 192.168.50.90:8283 with 186 endpoints
- OpenAPI spec available at /openapi.json

New 0.16.x API areas not in SDK:
- Archives (/v1/archives/) - 6 endpoints - standalone archive CRUD
- Conversations (/v1/conversations/) - 6 endpoints - new messaging abstraction
- Steps (/v1/steps/) - 7 endpoints - execution step tracking with trace/metrics/feedback
- Runs expanded (/v1/runs/) - 9 endpoints - metrics, usage, trace, stream
- MCP servers v2 (/v1/mcp-servers/) - 7 endpoints - dedicated MCP server management

Existing SDK modules that may need type updates:
- agents.rs (44 API endpoints, check for new fields)
- tools.rs (17 API endpoints, check for new fields)
- sources.rs (11 API endpoints, sources vs archives migration)
- messages.rs (7 API endpoints, check for conversations overlap)

title: Implement letta_job_monitor - Job Tracking and Management
CRITICAL: runs stream() does not handle Server-Sent Events
description:
The `stream()` method in `rust/vendor/letta/src/api/runs.rs` (lines 109-117) incorrectly handles SSE responses.

**Current implementation:**
- Sends empty JSON body `{}`
- Deserializes response as `serde_json::Value`

**Problem:** The runs stream endpoint returns SSE, not plain JSON. This will fail at runtime.

**Required fix (follow conversations.rs pattern):**
- Accept optional parameters: starting_after, include_pings, poll_interval, batch_size
- Set `Accept: text/event-stream` header
- Use `bytes_stream().eventsource()` to parse the stream
- Return a stream type (e.g., `RunStream`), not `serde_json::Value`

title: Optimize letta_agent_advanced response sizes (22 operations)
CRITICAL: McpServerConfigV2 StreamableHttp variant unreachable
description:
The `#[serde(untagged)]` attribute on `McpServerConfigV2` in `rust/vendor/letta/src/types/mcp_server.rs` (lines 68-78) causes the `StreamableHttp` variant to be unreachable during deserialization.

**Root cause:** `CreateSseMcpServerConfig` and `CreateStreamableHttpMcpServerConfig` have identical field structures. With untagged deserialization, serde tries variants in declaration order and uses the first successful match. Any StreamableHTTP JSON will deserialize as the `Sse` variant instead.

**Proposed fix:**
Use `#[serde(tag = "mcp_server_type")]` (internally tagged) to discriminate based on the transport type field, or merge the two URL-based configs into a single variant.

MAJOR: bulk_delete has silent 50-agent cap and OR-based filter logic
description:
The `handle_bulk_delete` function in `letta-server/src/tools/agent_advanced/management.rs` (lines 188-243) has two issues:

**1. Silent cap:**
- Agent list fetched with `limit: Some(50)`
- If more than 50 agents match, excess are silently ignored
- Response doesn't indicate this ceiling was hit

**2. OR semantics (should be AND):**
- When both `agent_name_filter` and `agent_ids` provided, agent matching either is deleted
- Users providing both filters likely expect intersection (AND) behavior
- Current OR logic could accidentally delete more agents than intended

**Proposed fixes:**
- Add pagination to fetch all matching agents
- Change logic to require BOTH filters to match (AND)
- Include `total_matched` and `limit_applied` in response
